selection_policy.purpose: A compact primary-law layer for German early-stage founder decisions.
include: Rules directly governing legal-form characteristics, formation, registration, representation, liability, basic bookkeeping, founder tax classification, and founder-specific public support.
Complete short acts when almost every section is directly relevant to the supported decision domain.
exclude: Non-binding tables of contents, publication footers, amendment footnotes, and unrelated chapters of long statutes.
Repealed sections and rules without a direct connection to the three thesis decision domains.
selection_policy.review_rule: Every scope change requires a new manifest version, a fresh extraction audit, and a new index build before benchmark freeze.

documents.legal_area: civil law; GbR; legal capacity; entrepreneur and consumer status
documents.selection_reason: Keeps the entrepreneur/consumer definitions and the complete modern GbR subchapter while excluding unrelated family, inheritance, and general obligations law.

documents.legal_area: commercial law; merchant status; commercial register; OHG; KG; bookkeeping
documents.selection_reason: Covers merchant and register status, company-name basics, formation/management/representation/liability of OHG and KG, and founder-relevant bookkeeping duties.

documents.law_name: Gesetz betreffend die Gesellschaften mit beschränkter Haftung
documents.selection_reason: Includes formation, capital, UG, registration, pre-registration liability, legal personality, representation, accounting, and managing-director duties.

documents.legal_area: partnership law; liberal professions; professional liability
documents.selection_reason: The act is short and all sections contribute directly to formation, registration, representation, partner changes, or liability of professional partnerships.

documents.legal_area: company law; stock corporation; management liability
documents.selection_reason: Keeps the AG characteristics, capital, articles, registration, board management/representation, and board duty provisions needed for high-level legal-form comparison.
Covers cooperative purpose, statutes, formation, registration, legal personality, board structure, representation, and management duties.

documents.legal_area: trade law; business registration; regulated activities
documents.selection_reason: Includes general trade freedom and scope, business notification, operation without approval, common founder-facing regulated activities, and prohibition for unreliability.

documents.legal_area: craft law; Handwerksrolle; regulated and non-regulated crafts
documents.selection_reason: Covers permission and Handwerksrolle rules plus the official Annex A/B trade lists needed to determine whether a planned craft is regulated.

documents.legal_area: tax procedure; business notification; bookkeeping threshold
documents.selection_reason: Retains the founder-facing tax notification and statutory bookkeeping-threshold provisions.

documents.legal_area: income tax; EÜR; trade income; self-employed professions; distributions; retained profits
documents.selection_reason: Supports profit determination/EÜR, the distinction between commercial and self-employed professional income, and founder-facing taxation of distributions and retained profits.

documents.legal_area: corporation tax; taxable entities; income; tax rate
documents.selection_reason: Covers who is subject to corporation tax, the income basis, and the statutory rate used in legal-form comparisons.

documents.legal_area: trade tax; taxable business; trade income; allowance
documents.selection_reason: Supports taxable-subject, trade-income, tax-base, and natural-person/partnership allowance questions without indexing unrelated calculation details.

documents.legal_area: value added tax; entrepreneur status; tax rates; filing; small-business rule
documents.selection_reason: Covers taxable transactions, VAT entrepreneur status, standard and reduced tax rates, filing procedure, and the small-business rule.
Only the two statutory provisions governing eligibility, duration, and amount of the Gründungszuschuss enter the funding corpus.
